item.title: my picture journal from san francisco i can’t believe i got to...
item.description: my picture journal from san francisco i can’t believe i got to wear a cardigan (la has been way too hot)this book was crazy (and this tea was incredible)eucalyptus trees (no koala) i liked these catsi liked the cable car :))fun fact i will point at every squirrel on a walk@sammyraemusic was incredible ily yumwe played geography quizzes on the globelook at all those chickens!i saw a bridge! thanks san francisco see you soon!!
